description:
For one specialty (neurologist, orthopedist, dermatologist...): the Ministry of Health's community wait figures (dated), and per insurer the online-consultation and fast-track routes (does the document name this specialty, who chooses the doctor, promised times word for word, what you pay), plus the private-visit refund rows. For psychiatry, emergency and support lines come first.
התור בקופה לרופא מומחה רחוק: נתוני משרד הבריאות, והמסלולים בפוליסות (ייעוץ מקוון, תור מהיר, החזר על ביקור פרטי).

company.description: The person’s insurer, if they named it (Hebrew or English): the answer is then only that company, and much shorter. Without it: every company, alphabetical.

specialty.description: cardiology, dermatology, endocrinology, ent, gastroenterology, gynecology, neurology, ophthalmology, orthopedics, psychiatry, urology (or the Hebrew name, e.g. נוירולוג)

name: specialist_routes
title: Getting to a specialist fast
